# ==============================================================================
# STANDALONE RANK PRODUCTS ANALYSIS & VISUALISATION SCRIPT
# ==============================================================================
```{r}
# 1. LOAD LIBRARIES
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(RankProd)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

# 2. SETUP OUTPUT DIRECTORIES
dge_out_dir <- here("Analysis/Data/DGE/RankProducts")
fig_out_dir <- here("Analysis/Figures/RankProducts")
dir.create(dge_out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(fig_out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# 3. LOAD SAMPLE METADATA
s2c <- read_csv(here("Raw","results","run_metadata.txt")) %>% 
  mutate(path = gsub("/abundance.tsv", "", paste0(here("Raw","results"), "/", path)),
         name = gsub("_0h_\\d$", "", name),
         sample = paste0(name, "_",  timepoint, "_", biorep),
         name = factor(name),
         timepoint = factor(timepoint),
         biorep = factor(biorep)) %>%
  mutate(
    experiment = if_else(name %in% c("pmk1", "Guy11M"), "Exp2", "Exp1"),
    experiment = factor(experiment, levels = c("Exp1", "Exp2"))
  )

# 4. HELPER FUNCTIONS
# Extract TPM matrix from kallisto outputs
get_tpm_matrix <- function(s2c_subset) {
  tpm_list <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(s2c_subset)), function(i) {
    abund_file <- file.path(s2c_subset$path[i], "abundance.tsv")
    read_tsv(abund_file, col_types = cols()) %>%
      select(target_id, tpm) %>%
      rename(!!s2c_subset$sample[i] := tpm)
  })
  
  tpm_mat <- reduce(tpm_list, full_join, by = "target_id")
  rownames_mat <- tpm_mat$target_id
  tpm_mat <- tpm_mat %>% select(-target_id) %>% as.matrix()
  rownames(tpm_mat) <- rownames_mat
  return(tpm_mat[, s2c_subset$sample, drop = FALSE])
}

# The CORE Rank Products Function (Fixed for proper mirroring)
run_rank_products <- function(s2c_all, group1_name, group2_name, tp_filter) {
  
  message("\n--- Running RP: ", group1_name, " vs ", group2_name, " (", tp_filter, "H) ---")
  
  # Filter to samples and FORCE ORDER (Group 1 samples must come first in matrix)
  s2c_sub <- s2c_all %>%
    filter(name %in% c(group1_name, group2_name), timepoint == tp_filter) %>%
    mutate(name = factor(name, levels = c(group1_name, group2_name))) %>%
    arrange(name) %>%
    droplevels()

  if (nrow(s2c_sub) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  # Prepare Matrix
  tpm_mat <- get_tpm_matrix(s2c_sub)
  expr_mat <- log2(tpm_mat + 0.5)
  
  # Class vector: 1 for numerator group, 0 for denominator group
  n1 <- sum(s2c_sub$name == group1_name)
  n2 <- sum(s2c_sub$name == group2_name)
  cl <- c(rep(1, n1), rep(0, n2))
  
  # Run RankProd
  rp_result <- RP(data = expr_mat, cl = cl, num.perm = 100, 
                  logged = TRUE, gene.names = rownames(expr_mat), plot = FALSE)
  
  # Extract results (cutoff=1 extracts all genes)
  tg <- topGene(rp_result, cutoff = 1, method = "pfp", logged = TRUE, logbase = 2)
  
  tidy_table <- function(tbl, direction) {
    if (is.null(tbl) || nrow(tbl) == 0) return(NULL)
    as.data.frame(tbl) %>%
      rownames_to_column("target_id") %>%
      mutate(direction = direction, timepoint = as.character(tp_filter), 
             comparison = paste0(group1_name, "_vs_", group2_name))
  }
  
  res_df <- bind_rows(
    tidy_table(tg$Table1, paste0("up_in_", group1_name)),
    tidy_table(tg$Table2, paste0("up_in_", group2_name))
  )
  
  # Save CSV
  out_file <- file.path(dge_out_dir, paste0("rankprod_", tp_filter, "H_", group1_name, "_vs_", group2_name, ".csv"))
  write_csv(res_df, out_file)
  return(res_df)
}

# 5. EXECUTE ANALYSIS
timepoints <- levels(s2c$timepoint)

# Run comparisons and their inverses to generate correctly mirrored data
results_list <- list()

for (tp in timepoints) {
  results_list[[paste0("pmk1_vs_mst7_", tp)]]     <- run_rank_products(s2c, "pmk1", "mst7", tp)
  results_list[[paste0("mst7_vs_pmk1_", tp)]]     <- run_rank_products(s2c, "mst7", "pmk1", tp)
  results_list[[paste0("Guy11_vs_Guy11M_", tp)]]  <- run_rank_products(s2c, "Guy11", "Guy11M", tp)
  results_list[[paste0("Guy11M_vs_Guy11_", tp)]]  <- run_rank_products(s2c, "Guy11M", "Guy11", tp)
}

# Combine all results into one master dataframe
rp_all <- bind_rows(results_list) %>% 
  mutate(sig = !is.na(pfp) & pfp < 0.05)

# 6. GENERATE MIRRORED VISUALISATIONS
comparisons <- unique(rp_all$comparison)

for (comp in comparisons) {
  # Identify G1 (Right side) and G2 (Left side) based on the comparison name
  grps <- strsplit(comp, "_vs_")[[1]]
  g1 <- grps[1]
  g2 <- grps[2]
  
  plot_df <- rp_all %>%
    filter(comparison == comp, sig) %>%
    mutate(
      # If the 'direction' tag from analysis matches the first group in the name, it's "up"
      dir_simple = if_else(direction == paste0("up_in_", g1), "up", "down"),
      timepoint_num = as.numeric(gsub("H", "", timepoint)),
      timepoint = fct_reorder(timepoint, -timepoint_num) # 0H at top, 24H at bottom
    ) %>%
    count(timepoint, dir_simple) %>%
    mutate(n_plot = if_else(dir_simple == "down", -n, n))

  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) {
    message("No significant genes to plot for: ", comp)
    next
  }
  
  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(y = timepoint, x = n_plot, fill = dir_simple)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(up = "#D62728", down = "#1F77B4"),
                      labels = c(up = paste0("Higher in ", g1), 
                                 down = paste0("Higher in ", g2))) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = abs) +
    labs(title = paste0("Rank Products DEGs: ", gsub("_vs_", " vs ", comp)),
         subtitle = "Mirror Bar Chart (pfp < 0.05)",
         x = "Number of DEGs", y = "Timepoint", fill = NULL) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
  
  # Save plots as SVG
  ggsave(file.path(fig_out_dir, paste0("rankprod_mirrored_", comp, ".svg")), 
         p, width = 8, height = 6)
  
  # Show plot in console/IDE
  print(p)
}

message("\nDONE! Results saved in:")
message("CSVs:  ", dge_out_dir)
message("Plots: ", fig_out_dir)
```
